verdicts.note: Separate check from symbol order (A1); flags whitespace between currency symbol and numerals.
Testable rule flagging a full stop after the cents abbreviation 'c' when not sentence-ending.
Testable rule requiring country prefix followed by '$' for non-Australian dollar currencies.
Testable consistency rule requiring IBAN codes across all referenced currencies when IBAN is used.
G-3: Relaxes A8 by permitting the symbol 'A£' or 'former Australian pounds' if confusion is possible.
G-5: Advice to the writer about precision; cannot be violated by text.
Testable rule prohibiting a space or full stop when using 'm' for million in tables or charts.
G-5: Advice to the writer to provide an explanatory note for the abbreviation.
